name: pakkun_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite, side view, a huge monster made of thick glossy brown paint rising out of a wide, lumpy puddle of the same paint on the floor. From the middle of the puddle a long, thick neck of flowing paint curves up and forward to the left, ending in a big round head that is mostly one huge gaping mouth with thick, puffy, fleshy lips around its rim, like a giant goopy bowl tipped toward the left. Brown and cream paint pours and drips heavily out of the mouth and runs back down the neck into the puddle. Rich chocolate-brown paint with wide swirling cream-white marble streaks and a few thin golden streaks, strong wet highlights, bubbles on the puddle surface. Slimy and disgusting yet a little comical, a living sludge monster. Plain flat background, the monster alone.
refs: shape and silhouette: a wide paint puddle, a long curved neck of flowing paint, a round head with a thick rim around a big open mouth, paint pouring out; the glossy brown and cream marble swirls; draw it as pixel art, facing left
